warnings.summary: no %PDF-x.y header in the first 1,024 bytes; parsing went ahead
warnings.hint: nothing to do if the document reads correctly; open in strict mode to refuse such files

warnings.summary: the stored cross-reference data was unusable and was rebuilt by scanning
warnings.hint: check the result; save with a full rewrite, since an incremental update refuses a repaired base

warnings.summary: a hybrid file's /XRefStm could not be read and was ignored
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the classic xref table is used instead

warnings.summary: a stream's /Length was wrong, so its end was found by scanning for endstream
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a full rewrite writes the correct length

warnings.summary: a reference's generation did not match its xref entry, so it resolved to null
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the reference is treated as missing

warnings.summary: a page-tree node was missing, malformed or too deep, and was skipped
warnings.hint: check the page count: pages under the skipped node are missing

warnings.summary: the page tree's /Count differs from the number of pages walked
warnings.hint: nothing to do; Lamina PDF uses the walked page count

warnings.summary: Flate data was truncated or had a bad checksum; the partial output was kept
warnings.hint: check the affected content: the end of the stream may be missing

warnings.summary: an object stream's index was stale and the object was found by searching
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a full rewrite writes a correct index

warnings.summary: an xref entry above max_object_number was dropped
warnings.hint: raise max_object_number in Limits only if you trust the input

warnings.summary: AES-encrypted data had a bad length or padding and was kept as stored
warnings.hint: treat the affected strings and streams as suspect: they may have been tampered with

warnings.summary: an R5/R6 document's /Perms does not match its /P and /EncryptMetadata
warnings.hint: treat the document's permissions as untrusted

warnings.summary: more than max_warnings warnings were raised and the rest were dropped
warnings.hint: raise max_warnings in Limits if you need the full list

warnings.summary: a page boundary box is not four numbers and reads as absent
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the page uses the next box in the fallback chain

warnings.summary: a page's /Rotate is not a multiple of 90 and reads as 0
warnings.hint: set the page rotation explicitly if 0 is wrong

warnings.summary: a name- or number-tree node was malformed, repeated or too deep, and was skipped
warnings.hint: check the tree's entries: those under the skipped node are missing

warnings.summary: an outline item was reached twice; that branch of the walk stopped
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the outline is read without the loop

warnings.summary: an outline item was missing, not a dictionary or too deep, and was skipped with its subtree
warnings.hint: check the outline: the skipped item and its children are missing

warnings.summary: an Info date is not a valid PDF date; the raw string is kept
warnings.hint: read the raw value from the Info view if you need it

warnings.summary: the XMP metadata packet is not readable XMP and reads as absent
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a metadata edit asks before replacing it

warnings.summary: two annotations on one page have the same name (/NM), which should be unique on its page
warnings.hint: nothing to do; both are kept, and annotations are told apart by their own IDs

warnings.summary: the XMP metadata packet had damage other readers read past, and was read the same way
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a metadata edit writes the declarations the packet left out

warnings.summary: a /PageLabels entry is malformed; the malformed part is dropped
warnings.hint: nothing to do; affected pages fall back to decimal labels

warnings.summary: an entry a view reads is unreadable or of the wrong type and reads as absent
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the view uses the entry's default

warnings.summary: an operator the spec does not define was skipped outside a BX/EX section
warnings.hint: nothing to do; check the page's rendering if the operator mattered

warnings.summary: an operator had too few operands or operands of the wrong type, or extra ones
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the operator was skipped or used its last operands

warnings.summary: a Q without a matching q was ignored, or saved graphics states were left open
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the graphics state was restored as the spec intends

warnings.summary: a text object was opened twice, closed outside one, or left open
warnings.hint: nothing to do; text operators outside a text object were handled tolerantly

warnings.summary: an EMC without a matching BMC or BDC was ignored, or marked content was left open
warnings.hint: check tagged-content results: marked-content sequences were closed for you

warnings.summary: content-stream bytes that are not a token were skipped
warnings.hint: check the page's content: the bytes around the reported offset were skipped

warnings.summary: an operator named a resource that is missing, of the wrong type or unreadable
warnings.hint: check the page's resources: the operator ran without the resource or was skipped

warnings.summary: no EI ends an inline image; the rest of the content was skipped
warnings.hint: check the page's content: everything after the inline image is missing

warnings.summary: a Form XObject draws itself, directly or through other forms
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the inner Do was skipped

warnings.summary: a content stream ended with a path no painting operator ended
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the unpainted path was dropped as the spec intends

warnings.summary: a font dictionary has a missing or malformed entry, so its text was decoded with defaults
warnings.hint: nothing to do; extracted text or positions for that font may be off

warnings.summary: a font's CMap or ToUnicode CMap is malformed or names a predefined CMap Lamina PDF has no table for
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the bad entries were skipped and the rest of the CMap is used

warnings.summary: a font shows glyphs that nothing maps to text
warnings.hint: nothing to do; those glyphs extract as U+FFFD (the file needs a ToUnicode CMap)

warnings.summary: a page had more runs of text than the extraction block limit; the runs past it were left out
warnings.hint: raise ExtractLimits::max_blocks_per_page if the page really has that many blocks

warnings.summary: a page mixes horizontal and vertical writing, so the order of its blocks is a guess
warnings.hint: nothing to do; check the order of that page's blocks, or ask for content order

warnings.summary: a table's rules marked out merged cells that aren't rectangles, so its cells were kept unmerged
warnings.hint: nothing to do; check that table's cells, whose text may be split across neighbours

warnings.summary: a page's ruling lines would make a table bigger than the extraction's cell limit; those lines gave no table
warnings.hint: raise ExtractLimits::max_table_cells if the page really has a table that big

warnings.summary: a tagged page's structure tree covered too little of its text, or its order jumped back across columns too often, so the layout gave the reading order
warnings.hint: nothing to do; ReadingOrder::Tagged uses the tree anyway

warnings.summary: a page read in structure-tree order has visible text that is neither in the tree nor an artifact; it follows the tree's blocks, in layout order
warnings.hint: nothing to do; tag that text in the file to give it a place in the reading order

warnings.summary: a page has no usable text layer: it is an image (with or without an invisible OCR layer), outlined glyphs, or glyphs without Unicode, so its extracted text is empty or unreliable
warnings.hint: run OCR or a vision model on this page; the page's textLayer in the JSON says which case it is

warnings.summary: the layout rules had to guess how a page's columns are read, so its blocks may be in the wrong order; the blocks concerned have a lower confidence
warnings.hint: check the page, or send it to a layout model; the warning's reason says which guess was made

errors.summary: the input does not look like a PDF at all
errors.hint: check that the bytes passed to open are a PDF file

errors.summary: no document catalog (/Root) was found, even after repair
errors.hint: use another copy of the file: this one has no usable catalog

errors.summary: a reference chain or the page tree loops back on itself
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a hard Limits value was exceeded
errors.hint: the input exceeds a safety limit; raise {limit} in Limits only if you trust the input

errors.summary: strict mode refused something the tolerant reader would have repaired
errors.hint: open without strict mode to read the file with repairs, or fix the file

errors.summary: the ByteSource has not fetched the byte ranges the call needs yet
errors.hint: fetch the listed ranges into the source and retry the call
retry the call, or check the source; the document stays usable

errors.summary: an object had a different type than the structure requires
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: an object stream, xref section or filter parameter was malformed
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a writer object number was reserved but never given a value
errors.hint: this is a bug in Lamina PDF: report it with the steps that led to it

errors.summary: an incremental update was requested for a document whose xref needed repair
errors.hint: save with a full rewrite instead of an incremental update

errors.summary: a save of an encrypted document was requested
errors.hint: saving encrypted documents is not supported yet; use another tool to decrypt or re-encrypt

errors.summary: the document is encrypted with a user password and none was given
errors.hint: pass the document's password in OpenOptions

errors.summary: the given password is neither the user nor the owner password
errors.hint: ask for the password again and retry with the correct one

errors.summary: the document uses a security handler Lamina PDF cannot decrypt
errors.hint: use a tool that supports this encryption to decrypt the file first

errors.summary: the input ended before a complete token or object was read
errors.hint: use a complete copy of the file: this one looks truncated

errors.summary: a token or structure did not match the PDF grammar
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a stream uses a filter Lamina PDF does not implement
errors.hint: use a tool that supports the filter to read this stream
use another copy of the file: this stream's data is damaged

opErrors.summary: a transaction was started, or undo or redo called, while one is open
opErrors.hint: commit or roll back the open transaction first, or use a savepoint inside it

opErrors.summary: apply, commit or rollback was called without an open transaction
opErrors.hint: call begin first, or use transact

opErrors.summary: an op names a page the document does not have
opErrors.hint: use a PageId from this document's pages()

opErrors.summary: the page is a direct dictionary, which ops cannot edit yet
opErrors.hint: rewrite the file so that every page is an indirect object, or wait for page-structure ops

opErrors.summary: an op log has a schema version this reader does not know
opErrors.hint: upgrade Lamina PDF to a version that reads this op log version

opErrors.summary: an op log does not parse: an unknown op or field, a bad value, or not JSON
opErrors.hint: validate the op log against the op schema; the samples in fixtures/ops show the format

opErrors.summary: the document was saved to a sink Lamina PDF cannot read back and waits for rebase
opErrors.hint: call rebase with the saved bytes before applying ops or saving again

opErrors.summary: rebase was called without a save waiting for it
opErrors.hint: call rebase only after a save that returned SavedNotRebased

opErrors.summary: a metadata edit would replace the document's XMP packet, which can't be read, losing what it holds
opErrors.hint: set replaceMalformed on the edit to replace the packet with a new one, or leave the metadata as it is

opErrors.summary: an op or a call names a source document that was not added to the session
opErrors.hint: add the source document's bytes with addSource before applying ops that name it

opErrors.summary: an outline op names a bookmark the outline does not have
opErrors.hint: read the outline again and use one of its item IDs; an item a previous op deleted is gone

opErrors.summary: the bookmark is stored inside another item rather than as an object of its own, so outline ops can't name it yet
opErrors.hint: apply any other outline op first: it rewrites the outline and gives every bookmark an object and an ID of its own

opErrors.summary: the position names a bookmark that is not a child of the parent the op names
opErrors.hint: name a position among the parent's own children, or use first or last

opErrors.summary: a move would put a bookmark inside itself or one of its descendants
opErrors.hint: choose a parent outside the bookmark's own branch

opErrors.summary: the op names a destination the file does not define
opErrors.hint: list the file's named destinations and use one of their names

opErrors.summary: a rename to a name another destination already has
opErrors.hint: choose a name no destination has, or delete the other one first

opErrors.summary: a destination name is empty
opErrors.hint: give the destination a name of at least one character

opErrors.summary: a web address that isn't an absolute http, https or mailto address in plain ASCII
opErrors.hint: use a full address such as https://example.com/page; encode other characters with %

opErrors.summary: a destination's coordinates and zoom must be finite numbers
opErrors.hint: pass finite numbers, or null to keep the viewer's current value

opErrors.summary: an XMP edit would change the file's PDF/A or PDF/UA identification, which only conversion or a check may set
opErrors.hint: leave the pdfaid: and pdfuaid: properties as they are; edit the other properties, or keep them unchanged in a replaced packet

opErrors.summary: the XMP packet given to replace the document's doesn't parse
opErrors.hint: fix the XML at the offset in the error's data (reason says what is wrong), then replace the packet again

opErrors.summary: an XMP property edit names a property, or gives a value, that can't be written
opErrors.hint: check the part the error's reason names: the namespace, prefix, name, value, or the shape a mirrored property needs

opErrors.summary: a page deletion would leave the document with no pages
opErrors.hint: keep at least one page: delete all but one, or insert a blank page first

opErrors.summary: an op's values are out of range, such as a page count or a page size
opErrors.hint: insert between 1 and 10,000 pages at a time, each with a width and height above 0 and up to 14,400 points

opErrors.summary: the op names an annotation that no page of the document lists
opErrors.hint: read the page's annotations again and use an ID from that list

opErrors.summary: the annotation's flags forbid the change: Locked forbids deleting it or changing its properties, LockedContents changing its contents
opErrors.hint: clear the lock with an update of its flags first, if you may

opErrors.summary: the annotation can't be edited by the annotation ops: it is a form field's widget, or a direct dictionary with no object of its own
opErrors.hint: edit a widget through its form field; an annotation stored inside the page's list can't be edited yet

opErrors.summary: page label ranges whose first isn't on the first page, that are out of page order or share a page, or that number from 0
opErrors.hint: give ranges in page order, the first on the document's first page, each numbered from 1 or more

opWarnings.summary: the file claims PDF/A-1, which allows one author, and its metadata lists more
opWarnings.hint: keep one author (join the names into one), or save knowing the file no longer meets PDF/A-1

opWarnings.summary: the file claims PDF/UA-1, which requires a title in its metadata, and it has none
opWarnings.hint: give the document a title before saving, or save knowing the file no longer meets PDF/UA-1

opWarnings.summary: the file claims PDF/A, which requires the Info dictionary and the XMP packet to agree, and they differ
opWarnings.hint: edit the metadata with setMetadata, which writes both, or remove the Info entries that differ

opWarnings.summary: a duplicated page's content is partly untagged, which breaks the PDF/UA claim of the document's metadata
opWarnings.hint: retag the copy, or duplicate pages whose tagged elements lie on the page alone

saveErrors.summary: the sink failed to take the bytes or could not give them back
saveErrors.hint: check the destination and retry the save; the document is unchanged

saveErrors.summary: the output was written, but rebasing the document onto it failed
saveErrors.hint: retry rebase with the saved output carried by the error

saveErrors.summary: the sink already held bytes before the save started
saveErrors.hint: pass an empty sink: output offsets count from the sink's first byte

saveErrors.summary: the save would break one or more signatures
saveErrors.hint: save with SaveMode::Auto, or ask the user and retry with SaveOptions::with_invalidate_signatures

saveErrors.summary: an incremental save was requested but only a full rewrite is safe

textErrors.summary: font bytes could not be read as a font
textErrors.hint: pass the complete bytes of a .ttf, .otf, .ttc or .otc file

textErrors.summary: a font collection member past the end of the collection was asked for
an instance was asked for on a variation axis the font does not have
textErrors.hint: check the font's axes before choosing coordinates, or use a variable font

textErrors.summary: the font's OS/2 fsType forbids embedding
textErrors.hint: use another font, or register it with EmbedPolicy::Override if your licence allows embedding

textErrors.summary: the font has no glyph for a character of the text
textErrors.hint: use a font that covers the character, or split the text across fonts

textErrors.summary: a glyph ID at or past the font's glyph count was used
textErrors.hint: pass glyph IDs from the font you registered

textErrors.summary: a FontKey was used with a registry that did not hand it out
textErrors.hint: use the key returned by this registry's add
try another version or format of the font, and report the font if it is a common one

textErrors.summary: a variation axis value was NaN or infinite
textErrors.hint: pass finite axis values; values outside the axis range are clamped

textErrors.summary: finish_fonts was given a document the registry did not reserve its fonts in
textErrors.hint: use one FontRegistry per document and finish it with that document

textErrors.summary: an OpenType feature setting did not parse
textErrors.hint: write it as liga=0, -liga, smcp or aalt=2 (HarfBuzz syntax without ranges)

textErrors.summary: a byte range was out of bounds or not on character boundaries of the text
textErrors.hint: take ranges from Lamina PDF's results (line_breaks, itemize, break_lines) and pass the same text

textErrors.summary: the styled spans given for a paragraph do not cover its text once, in order
textErrors.hint: give spans in text order, each starting where the one before ends, from byte 0 to the end of the text, between grapheme clusters, each with at least one font from the list

textErrors.summary: a layout option that is not implemented yet was asked for
textErrors.hint: leave the option at its default; justification comes with a later release

textErrors.summary: a shaped run was given with a font key for a different font than it was shaped with
textErrors.hint: pass the key of the font the run was shaped with (the font index of each line run maps to your keys)

textErrors.summary: a standard 14 font has no free one-byte code left for another glyph
textErrors.hint: embed a font with Font::from_bytes, or split the text across two registrations of the standard font

textErrors.summary: a standard 14 font was given to shaping or layout, which need a font program
textErrors.hint: draw standard 14 fonts with FontRegistry::encode, or shape with an embedded font

textWarnings.summary: one glyph was used for two different texts; ToUnicode keeps the first
textWarnings.hint: mark the second occurrence with /ActualText so extraction gets its text

textWarnings.summary: a font that forbids subsetting was rebuilt with every glyph kept
textWarnings.hint: check that the font's licence allows this, or use a static TrueType or CFF version

buildErrors.summary: image bytes are not a readable image of the format they were given as
buildErrors.hint: pass the complete bytes of a JPEG or PNG file to Image::jpeg or Image::png

buildErrors.summary: the image uses a feature that PDF or Lamina PDF does not support
buildErrors.hint: convert it to a baseline or progressive 8-bit JPEG, or to PNG

buildErrors.summary: the image needs more memory than the builder allows (a decoded PNG over 256 MiB, or raw dimensions whose size overflows)
buildErrors.hint: scale the image down before adding it

buildErrors.summary: raw image samples are not width x height x channels bytes long
buildErrors.hint: pass exactly 4 bytes (RGBA) per pixel, row by row

buildErrors.summary: the bytes are not a usable ICC profile
buildErrors.hint: pass a complete ICC profile with a Gray, RGB or CMYK data colour space

buildErrors.summary: a colour has the wrong number of components for its colour space
buildErrors.hint: give one component per channel of the colour space (/N of the ICC profile)

buildErrors.summary: a colour string is not of the form #rgb or #rrggbb
buildErrors.hint: write the colour as # followed by 3 or 6 hexadecimal digits

buildErrors.summary: a page size, box, /UserUnit, drawing value (coordinate, matrix, line width, dash, miter limit) or image size is not usable
buildErrors.hint: use finite coordinates, positive page sizes and /UserUnit, non-negative line widths and dashes, a miter limit of at least 1, and images of at least one pixel

buildErrors.summary: a text box's lines don't all fit its height and its options asked for an error
buildErrors.hint: make the box taller or the text shorter, or use Overflow::Clip and read TextLayout::overflow

buildErrors.summary: a link, outline item or destination names a page index the document doesn't have
buildErrors.hint: use a 0-based index below the document's page count

buildErrors.summary: a link or outline item names a destination that was never defined
buildErrors.hint: define it with Builder::destination before the build finishes, or link to a page

buildErrors.summary: page label ranges that don't start at page 0, don't increase, start past the last page or number from 0
buildErrors.hint: give ranges sorted by first page, the first at page 0, numbered from 1

buildErrors.summary: a structure element resumed or closed isn't open
buildErrors.hint: resume and close only elements this builder's pages opened with open_element, and close each once

buildErrors.summary: structure elements opened across pages were never closed
buildErrors.hint: close each element from open_element with Builder::close_element once its last page is finished

buildErrors.summary: the PDF version asked for is one the profile doesn't allow (PDF/UA-1, PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3 are based on PDF 1.7)
buildErrors.hint: leave the version at 1.7 (the default) or lower; PDF 2.0 needs PDF/A-4 or PDF/UA-2, which Lamina PDF doesn't write yet

buildErrors.summary: PDF/UA-1 needs a document title, and the metadata gives none
buildErrors.hint: set a title with Builder::metadata (Metadata::with_title)

buildErrors.summary: PDF/UA-1 needs the document's natural language, and none was set
buildErrors.hint: set the language with Builder::lang, such as "en-GB"

buildErrors.summary: a Figure or Formula has no alternate text (/Alt or /ActualText), which PDF/UA-1 requires
buildErrors.hint: give the figure or formula a description with Tag::with_alt or Surface::figure's alt, or draw decoration as an artifact

buildErrors.summary: content was drawn outside every structure element and artifact, which PDF/UA-1 forbids
buildErrors.hint: draw it inside Surface::tag (real content) or Surface::artifact (decoration)

buildErrors.summary: a heading skips a level (the first is not H1, or an H3 follows an H1), which PDF/UA-1 forbids
buildErrors.hint: start with H1 and go down one level at a time

buildErrors.summary: an unnumbered H heading shares its parent with another H, or the document also uses H1-H6, which PDF/UA-1 forbids
buildErrors.hint: use numbered headings (H1, H2, ...) throughout, or one H per section

buildErrors.summary: a table or list element sits in a parent its type doesn't allow (a TD outside a TR, a P directly in a Table)
buildErrors.hint: nest tables as Table > TR > TH/TD and lists as L > LI > Lbl/LBody

buildErrors.summary: a link annotation has no Link structure element (it was drawn inside an artifact), which PDF/UA-1 forbids
buildErrors.hint: draw links outside artifacts, so the builder gives each one a Link element

buildErrors.summary: a link annotation has no description (/Contents), which PDF/UA-1 requires
buildErrors.hint: pass a description as the link's contents

buildErrors.summary: a standard 14 font, which is never embedded, was used under a profile that needs every font embedded
buildErrors.hint: load a font file with Builder::font instead of Builder::standard_font

buildErrors.summary: a glyph was drawn without a Unicode value, which PDF/A-2u and PDF/UA-1 forbid
buildErrors.hint: remove NUL characters (U+0000) from the text, or choose PDF/A-2b, which doesn't need Unicode

buildErrors.summary: a DeviceCMYK colour or image was used, but the PDF/A output intent is sRGB
buildErrors.hint: use RGB or gray colours, or a CMYK colour with an ICC profile (Color::icc)

buildErrors.summary: PDF/A-2 doesn't allow attached files that aren't PDF/A themselves
buildErrors.hint: choose PDF/A-3b, which allows attached files of any kind

buildErrors.summary: an attached file has no MIME type, which every PDF/A profile requires
buildErrors.hint: pass the file's MIME type, such as text/xml or application/octet-stream

buildErrors.summary: a line or a figure of a flow is taller than the page's body, so no page can hold it
buildErrors.hint: make the figure smaller, the text size smaller or the page's margins narrower

buildErrors.summary: a flow's contents page kept changing its page numbers after four layouts
buildErrors.hint: report the flow that fails; a page break after the contents block may avoid it until it is fixed

buildErrors.summary: a laminapdf.document/1 document has an unknown key, a missing one or a value of the wrong kind
buildErrors.hint: data.pointer names the value; correct it against the document schema, and didYouMean lists the closest known keys

buildErrors.summary: a template's $data, $each or $item points to a value the data doesn't have
buildErrors.hint: data.pointer names the value the template asked for; add it to the data or correct the pointer

buildErrors.summary: a template's placeholder found data of the wrong kind: $each over something that isn't a list, or text from an object
buildErrors.hint: data.pointer names the value and data.expected the kind the template needs there

buildErrors.summary: a template would fill in more values, or nest deeper, than a document may hold
buildErrors.hint: data.limit is the limit it passed; repeat fewer items, or split the document

buildWarnings.summary: blocks kept together are taller than a page, so the flow split them
buildWarnings.hint: split the keep group or drop keep-with-next on a heading chain, or use a taller page

buildWarnings.summary: the Markdown holds raw HTML, which the PDF leaves out
buildWarnings.hint: write the content in Markdown instead of HTML, or remove the HTML

buildWarnings.summary: the Markdown names an image that wasn't supplied, so the PDF leaves it out
buildWarnings.hint: pass the image's bytes with MarkdownBuildOptions::with_image under the path the Markdown uses

renderErrors.summary: the requested tile is larger than the render limits allow; nothing was allocated
renderErrors.hint: request smaller tiles (256 to 512 pixels at high zoom) or raise RenderLimits if the larger bitmap is intended

renderErrors.summary: the render engine could not open the document or draw the page
renderErrors.hint: the file may be damaged or use a feature this engine can't draw; try the other backend, or report the file

renderErrors.summary: the render engine is not available: its library or module could not be loaded
renderErrors.hint: run cargo xtask fetch-pdfium or set LAMINA_PDF_PDFIUM_DIR to the folder holding the PDFium library

renderErrors.summary: an export's PNG, JPEG or TIFF encoder failed on a page that was drawn
renderErrors.hint: report it with the format and the page: the encoder writes into memory, so this is a bug in Lamina PDF

extractErrors.summary: a layout model, OCR engine or page renderer plugged into an extraction failed; the extraction stops with no partial result
extractErrors.hint: check the plug-in's own logs; extract without the model to get the rules-only result

extractErrors.summary: a model result was handed to an extraction job that hadn't asked for it, or was the other model's result
extractErrors.hint: call provide only while request() returns a request, with the result its kind asks for

extractErrors.summary: an extraction in one call was given a model whose results only the host can give: a host model, or a plug-in model without a page renderer
extractErrors.hint: step an extraction job and hand it each result with provide, or give the plug-in a page renderer

facadeErrors.summary: a CancelToken stopped the work; the job is finished and returned no partial result
facadeErrors.hint: nothing to do: this is the outcome the caller asked for; start a new job to try again

facadeErrors.summary: a job was stepped after it had finished, failed or been cancelled
facadeErrors.hint: stop stepping a job once a step returned its result or an error; create a new job

facadeErrors.summary: the document a job was created for changed (an edit, undo, redo, save or rebase) or a different document was passed to step
facadeErrors.hint: pass the document the job was created from, and don't change it while the job runs; create a new job

facadeErrors.summary: an earlier revision was asked for by an index past the file's last revision
facadeErrors.hint: ask for an index below the document's revision count

facadeWarnings.summary: a page draws text and then paints a shape, an image or an annotation over it, so the text is hidden but still in the file
facadeWarnings.hint: remove the text itself with a tool that deletes what a redaction covers, then save a full rewrite

facadeWarnings.summary: a page has redaction marks that were never applied, so the text under them is still in the file
facadeWarnings.hint: apply the redactions in a tool that removes what they cover, then save a full rewrite

facadeWarnings.summary: an earlier revision of the file holds text that the latest revision no longer has
facadeWarnings.hint: save the file as a full rewrite, which keeps only the latest revision

bindingErrors.summary: a builder or one of its pages was used after it finished
bindingErrors.hint: create a new builder or page: a finished one takes no more drawing, pages, fonts or settings

bindingErrors.summary: a document, builder or other handle was used after free(), or after the using block that held it ended
bindingErrors.hint: free a handle only after its last use; to keep working, open the document again or create a new builder

bindingErrors.summary: a value passed to a binding does not have the shape its type declares
bindingErrors.hint: pass the value the type declarations describe; the data field says what was wrong

bindingErrors.summary: a sparse source was given more bytes than its byte budget allows
bindingErrors.hint: raise the source's budget, or open the file with fewer bytes fetched (smaller blocks, no readahead)

bindingErrors.summary: an options record passed to a binding has a key Lamina PDF does not know
bindingErrors.hint: remove the key or correct its spelling; didYouMean lists the closest known names

packageErrors.summary: init() or loadText() named a different source for a module that is already loaded or loading
packageErrors.hint: call init and loadText with a source once, before the first load; later calls need no source

packageErrors.summary: page.text() was called on a document opened in the base module, which has no text extraction
packageErrors.hint: load the extract module (init with the extract option, or loadExtract) or the text module before opening the document

packageErrors.summary: a range source could not fetch input bytes: a network error, an HTTP status other than 200 and 206, a 206 whose Content-Range or length doesn't match the request, or a read that returned the wrong number of bytes
packageErrors.hint: check that the URL is reachable and that the server sends the CORS headers range requests need (Content-Range must be exposed); data.reason and data.status say what failed

packageErrors.summary: an @laminapdf/sdk function was called before init() finished loading the WebAssembly module
packageErrors.hint: await init() once before calling anything else in @laminapdf/sdk

packageErrors.summary: a remote file changed while it was being read: its ETag or length differs from the first response
packageErrors.hint: open the file again; the document already read parts of the old version and can't mix in the new one

packageErrors.summary: a font or text call was made on a builder of the base module, which has no fonts or text
packageErrors.hint: load the text module with init and the text option, or with loadText, before creating the builder that draws text

packageErrors.summary: the worker answered with a different protocol or package version than the client
packageErrors.hint: serve the worker file from the same @laminapdf/sdk build as the page; don't load it from a CDN or an older deploy

packageErrors.summary: the worker running Lamina PDF stopped (an uncaught error, a WebAssembly trap or out of memory); calls in flight were rejected
packageErrors.hint: call client.restart() and open the document again; report the file if it keeps happening

packageErrors.summary: the worker client failed with an error that isn't Lamina PDF's (a bug in @laminapdf/sdk/worker, or a result it couldn't send)
packageErrors.hint: this is a bug in Lamina PDF: report it with the call and the message; the worker keeps running

packageErrors.summary: the WebAssembly module trapped (a bug in Lamina PDF), so its instance was discarded and the next call gets a fresh one
packageErrors.hint: open the document again and retry; report the file and the call if it traps again

packageErrors.summary: the WebAssembly module ran out of memory (its maximum, or what the engine could give), so its instance was discarded and the next call gets a fresh one
packageErrors.hint: open fewer or smaller documents at once and free each when done; lower the open limits so hostile files fail sooner

packageErrors.summary: a handle was used after its WebAssembly instance was replaced, by reset() or after a trap
packageErrors.hint: open the document again or create a new builder: nothing from the old instance survives

cliErrors.summary: the command line doesn't parse: an unknown command or flag, a missing argument, a bad value, or stdin named twice
cliErrors.hint: run the command with --help to see its arguments

cliErrors.summary: a page range doesn't fit the grammar, or names a page the document lacks
cliErrors.hint: write pages as 1-5, z for the last page, r2 for the second from the end, or x3 to leave page 3 out; data.position is the character where the range went wrong

cliErrors.summary: the command would write a PDF to standard output, and standard output is a terminal
cliErrors.hint: redirect standard output to a file or a pipe, or write to a file with -o

cliErrors.summary: explain was given a code that isn't a Lamina PDF error or warning code
cliErrors.hint: check the spelling against didYouMean, or list every code at the docs URL

cliErrors.summary: the output file exists, or the command would modify its input in place, and --force wasn't given
cliErrors.hint: pass --force, or write to a new file with -o

cliErrors.summary: an input file, standard input or the password file couldn't be read
cliErrors.hint: check that the file exists and that you can read it; data.input names it

cliErrors.summary: the output couldn't be written: its folder is missing or read-only, the disk is full, or standard output closed
cliErrors.hint: check that the output's folder exists, that you can write to it and that the disk has room

cliErrors.summary: laminapdf mcp was given a path outside its --root folders, or a link that leads out of them
cliErrors.hint: use a path inside one of the server's --root folders, or start the server with another --root
